protocol.primaryComparison: both versus none on the same common planner
protocol.referenceComparison: both versus the validation-selected deadline-aware EMS
protocol.selection: Reuse existing weights, residual calibration and validation-selected settings. No training, tuning, or operating-policy selection on these test cases. Arrival and energy networks are disabled in all four factorial arms.

uncertainty: 95% percentile intervals from 5,000 paired bootstrap resamples of whole seeds; ten synthetic seed clusters in the frozen experiment. The fixture has learnable synthetic hints. No real-world or equivalent-service cost claim.
